claim.scope: User-authorized retirement of the exact manifest-listed obsolete external-SSD diagnostic arrays and rebuildable/superseded caches, with scoped preservation and CPU-only post-cleanup admission checks.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within exact-target and recorded metadata scope; same-lineage review is correlated.
claim.decay_trigger: Fresh writes can recreate cache pathnames; refresh inventory before another cleanup. Loss/change of retained inputs, recipes, source or weights may invalidate regeneration.

authorization: User explicitly requested removal of unnecessary and temporary files in the external SSD cogni-ml directory.

preservation.scope: Current quality experiment, canonical checkpoints, active q4-cache-v2, source/reference environments, original/final media, small reports/recipes, and full42/full43 36-block activation oracles. Exact candidate list has no protected inode overlap.
preservation.byte_hash_limit: Protected lstat path/inode/size/mtime/link metadata passed; all retained large weight/media bytes were not freshly rehashed.

retired_evidence.raw_arrays: Optional CPU condition snapshots; old 2/4/8/16-block PixelUMM reference outputs; DRAMA codec intermediate stages; derived Wan F32 quantization weights/projections.
retired_evidence.superseded_weights: Derived q4-cache-v1 payloads only; full canonical source checkpoint and current v2 retained.
retired_evidence.availability: Retained summaries describe historical observations. Old raw-array inventory/verifier commands require regeneration before raw reinspection; no backup or exact historical byte recovery is promised.

recreated_cache_metadata.scope: New Finder metadata file; original selected inode is gone. Left in place.

safety_fixtures: changed protected path rejects before unlink
verification.cpu_only_admission_input: Same authenticated four-segment 20-second fixture; formatted binary; no Metal/model run.
verification.limits: Per-inode allocated bytes and filesystem free-space delta have different scopes; unrelated writes and delayed reclamation affect the latter. A new reader can race after the lsof precheck.
